text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, hii, fuu*... Compared to long distances,
2000m really is busy~. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"We can put on a great match every single time, can't we?
Yeah, totally...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Once again, my legs gave out...
In a middle distance race...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, good work, Kris S-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Did you see it—the Mission?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm, missions...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way you'd realize it while running.
You're giving everything you have to what's right in front of you..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see. If you can't see it, then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Next.
—I will run the next one, and the one after that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Pursuing the same Mission works just as well.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Revitalize the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Liven up... the racing world...
That's Kris S-chan's mission...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAT?
Me tooooo!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes, together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No way no way no way.
I mean, it totally doesn't suit me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The whole racing world? Come on,
I can't carry something that huge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then... let me hear it one day.
—Your mission.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kris S-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A mission for me... uniquely mine, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
umm~ I have a question for you~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why was I running
in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly hit with such a fundamental question,
I was at a loss for how to answer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if I don't know, and you don't know either, Trainer...
then no one knows, do they...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just thought of something.
Maybe it's 'to win'?
choice_data_list: I think the real problem is 'what comes after victory,' though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because there is something beyond victory,
Umamusume wish to win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning felt like merely a checkpoint along the way,
rather than the ultimate goal itself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond victory... What lies beyond victory,
for example..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"My reward... okonomiyaki.
And then..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"A reward... day off...
The zoo or something sounds super fun..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yikes...
I've been way too short-sighted about this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Should I think about this a bit more?
Even if you tell me that, though~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle seemed to be searching
for clues toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's dreams and goals are different, and there's no
fixed shape to them. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a place to draw inspiration from.
A place where dream-chasing Umamusume from all over the world gather.
choice_data_list: Shall we go? To the fair of dreams.
Wanna go? To the showcase of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A showcase of dreams...?
choice_data_list: Which means, onto the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup...
An international GⅠ where Umamusume gather from all over the world...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it feels like so many dreams
will gather over there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'I want to be called the nation's representative,'
or 'I want to be number one in the world and brag about it.'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to go to the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you wanna see the dreams of all kinds of Umamusume, huh!
To make up for just coasting along until now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An awareness beginning to sprout.
The place where the dreams of the entire world gather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Will Hishi Miracle be able to find her very own dream at the Japan Cup?
